  1. Requirements definition
  2. REQ-F70-EU-QN-01

Quiet, solid-feeling cabin without rattles

Proposal
1, implement. Front door complaints (16 rows, 13 defects: buzzing, rattles) support the study gaps in quietness (7.62 vs peer 8.79, the largest gap of the car) and build quality (7.95 vs 8.23).
Horizon
H1. Acoustic package and assembly fixes.
Domain
Quality Perception & NVH
Markets
EU
Evidence level
B (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1

Statement

Doors and interior trim shall be free of rattles and buzzing, and the cabin noise at motorway speed shall match the premium compact segment.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
EUStudy quietness (1-10)>= 8.5 (today 7.62, peer 8.79)Next EU customer study waveevidence
EUInterior noise at 130 km/hSegment benchmark (value to be set by engineering)Acoustic measurementassumption
